scripts.dev:inner: node ./node_modules/concurrently/dist/bin/concurrently.js -n api,frontend -c green,yellow "npm run api" "npm run frontend"
scripts.dev:local: npm run mode:local && npm run dev; npm run mode:hosted
scripts.mode:local: cp api/.env.local.example api/.env.local && cp frontend/.env.local.example frontend/.env.local && echo 'Switched to LOCAL mode.'
scripts.mode:hosted: rm -f api/.env.local frontend/.env.local && echo 'Switched to HOSTED/GCP mode.'
